backlog_items.title: Implement user authentication system
backlog_items.description: Add secure user authentication with email/password and social login options. Include password reset functionality and session management.
acceptance_criteria: Users can register with email and password
Users can login with social providers (Google, GitHub)
Password reset functionality works via email
Sessions are properly managed and secured
All authentication flows are tested

backlog_items.title: Create responsive dashboard layout
backlog_items.description: Design and implement a responsive dashboard that works across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports. Include data visualization components and navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard is fully responsive across all breakpoints
Data visualization components are interactive
Navigation is intuitive and accessible
Performance meets <2s load time requirement
Design follows established design system

backlog_items.title: Set up automated testing pipeline
backlog_items.description: Implement comprehensive testing pipeline including unit tests, integration tests, and visual regression testing. Integrate with CI/CD workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Unit test coverage >80% for all components
Integration tests cover all API endpoints
Visual regression tests catch UI changes
Tests run automatically on PR creation
Test results are reported in PR comments

backlog_items.title: Implement data persistence layer
backlog_items.description: Set up database schema and data access layer for storing user data, tracking entries, and application state. Include migration scripts and backup strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Database schema matches architecture data model
Data access layer provides CRUD operations
Migration scripts handle schema changes safely
Backup and recovery procedures are documented
Data validation and constraints are enforced

backlog_items.title: Add accessibility compliance features
backlog_items.description: Implement WCAG 2.1 AA compliance features including screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and high contrast mode support.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Screen reader support is comprehensive
Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards
Focus indicators are clearly visible
Accessibility testing is automated
